summary: Ran the full PortalShell-family device walk across 12 target routes at 6 viewports (375, 390, 414, 768, 1280, 1920), signed in as Super Admin (jaymn.judd@mascigc.com). No-horizontal-scroll contract PASSED on 71/72 (route × viewport) cells. ONE hard FAIL: /admin/communications overflows on ALL three mobile viewports (375/390/414) — root cause is an unwrapped <table class="min-w-full text-xs"> (Gap-analysis table) rendering ~668px wide. Additionally, /admin/executive-overview does NOT mount PortalShell at any viewport (no shared header, no •••, no H1) — violates Phase 15 mount requirement. Four listed routes (/fleet, /admin/ai, /admin/storage, /fl) return the app 404 page (not registered in AppRoutes). /safety renders its own chrome (no shared PortalShell). All 4 route aliases (/admin/occ, /executive, /executive-dashboard, /admin/executive) redirect correctly. Mobile •••, its aria-label ('More options'), and the three popover items (search / portal-switcher / lang-toggle) are all present on every page that DOES mount PortalShell.

/admin/executive-overview.note: DOES NOT MOUNT PortalShell at any viewport — page renders raw tiles only, no header/H1/breadcrumb/•••

/safety.note: renders bespoke Safety layout (no shared PortalShell). Not a defect unless spec requires shared shell.

h1_wrap_check_mobile_390.note: All rendered H1s wrap by words (line-height×lines pattern) — no per-letter vertical columns observed on any page.

unexpected_4xx_notes: Many 429 (Too Many Requests) responses appeared on /dispatch-portal, /safety, /admin/communications — attributable to the density of the automated walk (repeated backend probes in <2s) rather than a page defect. Suggest re-verifying manually if concerned.
One repeated 401 on /dispatch-portal before session cookies propagated (expected during login race).
Cosmetic console line `%c%d font-size:0;color:transparent NaN` on /safety — appears to be a 3rd-party analytics token dump, not a functional error.

ui_bugs.issue: Table renders at intrinsic width 668px, forcing document.scrollWidth to 441 on 390 viewport (668 minus surrounding padding). The 7-column table (GAP / SEVERITY / OWNER / TARGET / RISK / STATUS / BLOCKS PROD?) has no horizontal-scroll wrapper, so it pushes the whole page wider than viewport.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Wrap the <table class="min-w-full text-xs"> in a <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-3 sm:mx-0"> (or route it through <ResponsiveTable> if the design-system exposes one). Do NOT force-shrink columns; give the table its own horizontal scroll and constrain the outer card to `w-full min-w-0`. Also add `min-w-0` to the flex/grid parent that hosts this table so it will not blow out the shell. Verify document.documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth at 375/390/414 afterwards.

ui_bugs.issue: This route bypasses the shared PortalShell entirely — there is no ds-portal-shell wrapper, no shared header, no •••/search/portal-switcher/lang-toggle, no <h1>, no breadcrumb. Phase 15 requirement #2 explicitly asks us to report any PortalShell-family page that fails to mount PortalShell.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Wrap the Executive Overview page component in <PortalShell portal="admin" title="Executive Overview" breadcrumb={[{label:'Admin OS',to:'/admin'},{label:'Executive Overview'}]} primaryActions={[<RefreshButton/>]}> so it inherits the shared responsive header, mobile ••• overflow, search/portal-switcher/lang-toggle, and a proper <h1>. This also makes the D1/D2 aliases (/executive, /executive-dashboard, /admin/executive) land on a page that satisfies the responsive contract.

issues: 'Last Refresh' timestamp block on the right of the executive-verdict card is being pushed by fixed-width text; verify it uses flex-wrap or LongText once the table overflow is fixed — the table was the primary offender, this may resolve itself.

informational_missing_routes.note: The following routes listed in the Phase 15 sweep are NOT registered in AppRoutes and currently return the app 404 fallback. They passed the no-horizontal-scroll test because the 404 page is compact — but they clearly aren't the intended targets. Confirm whether these should exist or be dropped from the Phase 15 route list.

action_items: FIX (main agent): /admin/communications gap-analysis table — wrap in `overflow-x-auto` container + add `min-w-0` to parent so scrollWidth==clientWidth on 375/390/414. Selector: table.min-w-full.text-xs inside [data-testid^="admin-communications-gap-"] parent.

FIX (main agent): /admin/executive-overview — mount the shared PortalShell so it exposes header, H1 'Executive Overview', breadcrumb, and the mobile ••• with search/portal-switcher/lang-toggle popover.
CLARIFY (main agent): Confirm intent for /fleet, /admin/ai, /admin/storage, /fl — currently 404. Either register them or drop from Phase 15 sweep list.

CLARIFY (main agent): /safety intentionally uses its own chrome (no shared PortalShell). If Phase 15 requires shared shell for all portals in the family, this is also a mount gap; if /safety is exempt, ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: Any wide data table in a PortalShell page must be wrapped in a horizontal-scroll container OR routed through a ResponsiveTable primitive in /app/frontend/src/design-system/responsive.jsx. The Communications gap grid is the only page where this discipline slipped; consider adding a lint/regression assertion (already partially covered by /app/backend/tests/test_track_28_08_responsive_contract.py) to catch future regressions.

Route-level responsibility for PortalShell mounting is inconsistent: /admin/executive-overview is a leaf page component that renders directly instead of via <PortalShell>. Consider a route wrapper (HOC or layout route) so every /admin/* route inherits the shell by default.
